name: Duffel
tagline: Modern airline NDC-friendly flights API with sandbox and clear docs
description: Duffel provides a unified flights API for searching, booking, and managing airline offers via NDC and traditional GDS. Developers get REST endpoints for offers, orders, seats, and ancillaries, with sandbox access and production keys after signup.

auth.details: Bearer token via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY (test_ or live_ prefix); self-serve signup

example.request: curl -s -X GET "https://api.duffel.com/air/airports?iata_code=LHR" -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Duffel-Version: v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

use_cases: search one-way or round-trip flight offers by origin destination and dates
create a flight order from a selected offer
list seats and ancillaries for an offer
look up airports by IATA code
cancel or change a booking when the airline allows
